overview: The Medford High School Advisory Team convened separate initial listening sessions for its Educational Planning & Equity and Site Safety & Security subcommittees to gather baseline priority goals and concerns from municipal staff, educators, and community members.

items.title: Educational Planning & Equity Listening Session
items.summary: Advisory team members and educators shared their priority goals for the high school project, emphasizing flexible learning environments, specialized spaces for special education and English learners, collaboration hubs, and historical preservation.

items.title: Educational Planning & Equity Process and Wrap-Up
items.summary: The project team outlined upcoming design considerations, including restrooms and physical accessibility, and confirmed the next subcommittee meeting will take place on January 13.

items.title: Site Safety & Security Listening Session
items.summary: Participants discussed critical site logistics, focusing on vehicular and pedestrian traffic separation, ADA accessibility improvements, emergency access routes, and integration with the Middlesex Fells.

items.title: Site Safety & Security Process and Wrap-Up
items.summary: The subcommittee confirmed its next meeting for January 13 in a hybrid format, noting that sensitive physical security details will be reviewed in private sessions with public safety chiefs.

subject: High School Educational Planning and Safety Sessions
